facts.claim: Myconian Collection's weddings page (re-read live, modified 28 September 2026) says couples can exchange vows in a small whitewashed chapel followed by a reception on the beach or in one of its restaurants overlooking the Aegean and Mykonos town; it names its hotels in Elia as the wedding hotels and says it can prepare the stage for the couple's own team or provide a complete event solution (invitations, travel logistics, VIP transportation, menus, specialist cakes, wines, flowers, favours, lighting, sound and music, honeymoon planning) and fireworks over the bay. Re-confirms greece-wedding-venues fact_12 and greece-wedding-packages fact_25.

Myconian Collection's Horizons Ballroom is a semi-open space covered from above, with sliding doors onto a small balcony; it can be divided into four sections and accommodates 270 guests at round tables (8 to 10 per table), 380 to 400 in a banqueting layout and up to 550 for cocktails. Re-confirms greece-wedding-venues fact_13 unchanged.

Myconian Collection says it assists in officiating ceremonies across all denominations, has certified halal and kosher kitchens and a South Asian chef for traditional Indian cuisine, and its chefs' work has earned four Relais & Chateaux accolades; its guest transfer fleet includes luxury limousines, Porsche Cayennes, Mercedes 15-seat limo minibuses and 40-seat limo mini-coaches, with private jet, helicopter and yacht services on request. Re-confirms greece-wedding-venues fact_14 (Porsche Cayennes now also listed).
facts.conflicts: Transfer fleet now also lists Porsche Cayennes; greece-wedding-venues fact_14 listed limousines, minibuses and mini-coaches only. No numeric conflict.

facts.claim: Royal Myconian (royalmyconian.gr, site name 'Myconian Royal') and Myconian Imperial (myconianimperial.gr) each have a live 'Weddings & Events' page, but both carry the same shared Myconian Collection text ('from fairytale Mykonos weddings ... our luxury hotels in Mykonos are the go-to choice'; 'Our experienced events team look forward to helping you plan your event') with no hotel-specific ceremony space, capacity or wedding detail; the only hotel-specific lines are pool and beach (Royal: a pool terrace; Imperial: a twin-pool terrace; both: a private spot on Elia Beach). The wedding detail (chapel, Horizons Ballroom, capacities) sits only on the Myconian Collection weddings page, which names 'our hotels in Elia' collectively.
facts.conflicts: Royal Myconian and Myconian Imperial carry identical shared wedding text and the same hero image; neither page gives its own ceremony space or capacity, so they are treated as part of the single Myconian Collection (Elia) entry, not separate venues.

facts.claim: Grecotel Mykonos Lolita's own weddings page (grecotel.com/mykonos-lolita/weddings-mykonos/, modified 22 July 2026) offers 'Religious, civil & symbolic weddings at the hotel's chapel overlooking the deep blue and crystal-clear waters', describes the setting as off the beaten path and close to the island of Delos, and takes enquiries through a request-for-proposal form and the hotel's events email.

Grecotel Mykonos Lolita's homepage says it is 'a little hotel on a secluded private beach after Agios Sostis' (address Agios Sostis, Mykonos 846 00), with 'two whitewashed churches lingering above the Aegean' that 'provide a striking Cycladic setting for weddings and celebrations', a tiny restaurant above a cliff (the Veranda), independent suites and rooms on 2 levels overlooking the Aegean, an infinity pool with hydro massage, and a path down to the beach; it is near Agios Sostis beach and Panormos beach. Grecotel's group wedding page calls the Lolita private chapel 'Pure Cycladic bliss ... with infinite views to the Aegean sea'.
facts.conflicts: The Lolita homepage mentions 'two whitewashed churches'; the weddings page and the Grecotel group page refer to a single chapel ('the hotel's chapel', 'private chapel'). The article should say 'a private chapel' and not state a number of chapels.

facts.claim: Grecotel Mykonos Lolita's accommodation page lists six room and suite types (Classic Room, Classic Room Sea View, Junior Suite, Junior Suite Panoramic Sea View, Superior Suite, Grande Suite 2 Bedrooms), most for 2+1 persons and the Grande Suite for 4 adults, many with views of Panormos Bay, plus a villa, Villa Thea. It does not publish a total room count or a wedding guest capacity.

Myconian Collection's Elia Beach page lists its Elia hotels as Avaton, Imperial, Panoptis, Royal, Utopia and the Villa Collection, describes Elia's 'long stretch of golden sand' beneath 'rugged Cycladic hills', says Myconian Imperial sits immediately above Elia Beach with a saltwater pool, and says the Royal Myconian has rooms and suites with private balconies or terraces, a panoramic pool deck, a spa and 'outstanding event facilities'. No room counts are published on this page.

Pietra e Mare (Mykonos Moments, Mr and Mrs White Hotels) official page, modified 11 March 2026: in Kalo Livadi, overlooking the Aegean, 'just 12 km from Mykonos Town', with sea-view rooms and suites and a freshwater pool; its services list (concierge, airport/port transfer on request, doctor, massage, valet parking) contains no mention of weddings, a chapel or events. The chapel and wedding services claims seen in search results came only from booking and travel resellers, which are not sources.

Ftelia Bay Hotel's own site (fteliabay.gr, an undated 'Explore Mykonos' blog post, read live) says a wedding ceremony and pre-dinner cocktail can be held 'at the private chapel of the Ftelia Bay Boutique Hotel with the traditional architecture and the sea views', or an event or wedding in the open-air pool area; enquiries go to the hotel's info email with guest numbers and rooms needed; set menus for receptions or cocktail parties are offered and the concierge can arrange transfers, beauty treatments, decoration and photography. There is no dedicated weddings page in the site menu, and no capacity, ceremony types or exclusive use are published.

Ftelia Bay Hotel's homepage describes itself as a 4-star hotel 'nestled in the north of Mykonos, right in the inner end of a wonderful bay' (address Ftelia Beach, Mykonos 846 00), with nine room and suite types from Standard Garden View (19 to 23 sq m) to Deluxe Suite Sea View with private hot jacuzzi (37 to 45 sq m), a pool, a restaurant and a spa area; no total room count is published. It does not describe itself as Cycladic on the homepage.

insider_details.detail: Only one venue in this batch publishes a seated number: the Myconian Collection's Horizons Ballroom takes 270 at round tables or 380 to 400 banquet style, so it suits the larger end of a 40 to 150 guest list; for Mykonos Lolita and Ftelia Bay, get the chapel and reception capacity in writing before shortlisting.

The Myconian Collection's own fleet runs 15-seat minibuses and 40-seat mini-coaches, so a 120-guest wedding moves in about three coach loads; plan the timeline around that before the ceremony time is fixed.

Royal Myconian and Myconian Imperial share one wedding text and one events team with the wider collection, so enquire once through the collection's weddings page and ask which hotel's chapel, beach and ballroom your date would use, rather than comparing the two hotels as separate venues.

Mykonos Lolita's rooms are mostly for 2+1 guests with one 2-bedroom Grande Suite and a villa, and it is a small hotel on a secluded beach beyond Agios Sostis, so expect to house part of a larger guest list elsewhere; ask whether a full-hotel booking is possible on your dates.

Mykonos Lolita states religious, civil and symbolic ceremonies at its chapel, which makes it one of the few venues here where the ceremony type is published; the Myconian Collection says only that it assists with ceremonies of all denominations.
